example.place: Eau Claire, Eau Claire County, WI

brief: Foundry and machine-works complex begun in 1875 (enlarged 1907 and 1952, demolished after 1985): two rubble-stone buildings that housed the original foundry and machine shop, attached to a massive red-brick erecting shop with a raised clerestory monitor roof and stepped gable ends, rows of tall segmental-arched window openings (many bricked or boarded) and a big central freight door. A plain one-storey concrete-block addition, a smokestack and a wide empty gravel yard complete the site.
